premises.text: Moving money in Africa is slow and costly, with isolated mobile-money wallets blocking cross-network, cross-border, and online payments
premises.evidence_span: There are more than 155 mobile money wallets running, isolated one from another in our continent

premises.text: A universal payment platform with a single API lets online merchants accept cash and mobile-money wallets
premises.evidence_span: WeCashUp is a universal mobile money payment platform that enables online merchants to accept all cash and mobile money wallet online through a single API

premises.text: Version 2.0 supports cash, mobile money, cards, bank mobile wallets, and cryptocurrencies with split-payment invites
premises.evidence_span: supports cash, mobile money, credit and debit card, bank mobile wallet, and cryptocurrencies

premises.text: A patented blockchain tunneling network interconnects payment channels for secure interoperability
premises.evidence_span: we have built the first blockchain tunneling network which is a global interoperability network that secures and interconnects all these payment channels

premises.text: Monetization combines a monthly fee and a transaction fee
premises.evidence_span: We charge a monthly fee and a transaction fee

value.text: Fast, secure, easy payments for the unbanked across currencies—including life-critical hospital payments
value.evidence_span: ease of transaction processing for the unbanked across currencies

secondary_value.text: Best conversion rate and highest security via blockchain ledger
secondary_value.evidence_span: We offer the best conversion rate, the highest security system using our blockchain ledger

causal_links.evidence_span: It can be a matter of life or death
accept all cash and mobile money wallet online through a single API
We charge a monthly fee and a transaction fee

notes: Payment-rail list and split-pay demo treated as feature cascade of the universal platform; blockchain/patents kept as core tech of that mechanism. Merchant counts and growth rates excluded as traction. Personal hospital story used as warrant for the payment-access problem, not a separate premise.
